summary: The test suite is exceptionally comprehensive and robust. It employs a multi-layered testing strategy including unit tests via bats, structural validation of the GitHub Actions workflow, and a full end-to-end test harness using `act`. It thoroughly covers all requirements (include/exclude, limits, fail-fast), properly tests negative scenarios and edge cases (max-size limits, missing files, invalid JSON), and uses smart design choices like `jq` normalization to prevent brittle assertions.
